About

| Craft × Clarity |
I started in graphic design and moved into product design, so I care about both craft and clarity.

I work from early discovery to high-fidelity UI: interviews, competitive analysis, wireframes, prototypes, usability testing and developer handoff.

I work comfortably with clients, product managers and developers, and I use AI tools to explore options faster without losing sight of the user.

Beyond the screen

I’m passionate about sports and I’ve been skateboarding for more than 13 years. I love nature and spending time outdoors, and I’m always keen to explore and try new things, a mindset I bring into my design work too.
